channel.title: Renton & Newcastle Dispatch
channel.description: Renton & Newcastle news, once a week, from the Renton & Newcastle Dispatch.

item.title: Renton is paying for a study of how to finish the lakefront trail from Gene Coulon Park to the Cedar River Trail
item.description: The Sam Chastain Trail would run along the south shore of Lake Washington to Cedar River Trail Park, a link first drawn in the city's 1990 trails plan.

item.title: Newcastle's council had a December 1 hearing on a transportation benefit district on Tuesday's agenda
item.description: A district would give the city its own money for street preservation and maintenance.

item.title: Both cities' 2027 property tax levies were up for adoption this week
item.description: Renton's, held to the 1% state limit, costs the average homeowner about $5 more a year, the city says; its 2027–2028 budget had a first reading Monday.

item.title: Renton's corner-store rule had its first reading Monday
item.description: It would allow cafés, bakeries, small groceries and barbers of up to 1,800 square feet on corner lots or within a half-mile walk of a major transit stop, open 7 a.m. to 9 p.m., with no drive-throughs.

item.title: leaves off the drain before the cold
item.description: Renton asks residents to clear leaves and debris from the storm drains on their street; a grate under wet leaves is how a rainy night puts water across the road.
